annotations.title: Let humans explain a text back in their own words

description: Real people read a text (instructions, terms, a message) and explain in their own words what it means or what they would do – so you see where humans misunderstand it. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

question.description: Optional question, default: 'In one or two sentences: what are you being asked to do?'

text.description: The text humans should read (no personal data).
